blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — San Carlos Bishop Gerardo Alminaza, president of Caritas Philippines, called for strict accountability and an urgent transition to distributed renewable energy (RE) following recurring power outages that have disrupted lives and local economies across the Visayas region. Addressing the ongoing grid instability, Alminaza cited findings from a recent report by the Center for Energy, Ecology, and Development (CEED), which revealed that coal power plants accounted for 5,492.3 megawatts of aggregated lost power capacity due to outages in the Visayas between January and June 2026.
